name: VS
recent: V.S. Industry Berhad 将于2027年1月8日召开第44届常年股东大会，并已向交易所提交最多10%已发行股份的雇员认股计划（ESOS）上市申请。公司同时更新多项与关联方的经常性关联交易股东授权，以及一名非执行董事在公开市场增持股份的权益变动。最新财报显示季度营收环比增长24.2%、同比增长16.3%，但净亏损2,196万令吉，净亏损率收窄至2.2%。
notable: 最多占已发行股份10%，并已向Bursa Securities提交上市申请。
将于2027年1月8日召开第44届常年股东大会，寻求股东批准董事费、董事连任、审计师续聘、股份发行授权及关联交易授权等议案。
非执行董事Wong Cheer Feng于2026年10月8日及26日分别在公开市场增持90万股及38万股普通股。
risks: 公司涉及一项重大诉讼（MATERIAL LITIGATION），具体内容未在摘要中披露。
可能对现有股东权益产生摊薄影响。
最新季度仍录得净亏损2,196万令吉，尽管亏损幅度较上季收窄。
earnings: 2026财年（截至7月31日）季度营收为9.986亿令吉，环比增长24.2%，同比增长16.3%；净亏损2,196万令吉，净亏损率为2.2%，较上季的4.1%净亏损率有所收窄。

recent_en: V.S. The company also renewed shareholder mandates for recurrent related party transactions and disclosed share acquisitions by a non-executive director. Latest results show quarterly revenue up 24.2% QoQ and 16.3% YoY, with a net loss of MYR21.96 million and net margin improving to -2.2%.
notable_en: Proposed establishment of an employees' share option scheme (ESOS) of up to 10% of issued shares, with listing application submitted to Bursa Securities.

44th Annual General Meeting scheduled for 8 January 2027 to seek shareholder approval for directors' fees, re-election of directors, re-appointment of auditors, share issuance mandate and related party transaction mandates.
Non-Executive Director Wong Cheer Feng acquired 900,000 and 380,000 ordinary shares in the open market on 8 and 26 October 2026 respectively.
risks_en: The company is involved in a material litigation, details of which are not disclosed in the summary.
The proposed ESOS may involve issuance of new shares of up to 10% of issued shares, potentially diluting existing shareholders.
The latest quarter remained loss-making with a net loss of MYR21.96 million, although the loss narrowed from the previous quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR998.64 million, up 24.2% QoQ and 16.3% YoY; net loss was MYR21.96 million with a net margin of -2.2%, narrowing from -4.1% in the previous quarter.
